title: Design Lead (TIVERIT)
purpose: Accountable lead for design deliverables from TIVERIT; represents overall multi-discipline design authority, approves design packages, and co-owns review processes in CDE.
authority_statements: Member access in ACC with read/write in design folders where needed
Authority to initiate and approve transmittals and review packages for design deliverables
Authority to approve design packages for milestone submissions
Does not manage platform members or folder permission configurations
responsibilities: Lead cross-discipline design integration and ensure design intent is achieved
Review and approve formal design deliverables prior to external transmittal
Participate in design review workflows in CDE and close design issues
accountabilities: Design quality, aesthetic coherence, and contractual compliance of design packages
On-time approval of design deliverables for scheduled milestones
approvals: Design deliverable packages and formal submittal sets
inputs: Discipline design packages from Discipline Leads
Client design briefs and stakeholder comments

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.

curator_scope.approval: Approves integrated design/package content for design intent and design-delivery release; distinct from discipline BIM/model readiness.
